target_estimation.method: Fixed componentwise median of transformed goal observations; yaw-only / z=0 projection

phase_review_notes: Pickup lacks a sustained adjacent stationary period; estimated motion onset only.
Release lacks a sustained adjacent stationary period; estimated motion end only.
Lowering begins away from the goal region; placement label is based on height motion only.
rejection_reasons: Unfilled tracking gap during pickup-to-release; reject for retargeting.

parameters.phase_override_reason: Seven complete alternating transfers confirmed in 2-second video contact sheets and 1-second placement review. Approximate pickup-to-release brackets include visible carrying and release. Automatic stationary segmentation is incomplete due occlusion and pose jitter. Timing annotations are reviewable, not contact ground truth.

demonstrations.coordinate_frame_convention: W is ID0 centre: +X decoded corner0 to corner1; +Y corner3 to corner0; +Z out of printed face. Standard41 corners reordered [1,0,3,2] for OpenCV IPPE. W_T_tag = inverse(C_T_W) @ C_T_tag. World ID1 is registered to ID0. World axes are not gravity-calibrated. Object centre = face centre minus edge/2 along outward tag Z; common object orientation is unspecified.
demonstrations.normalization: Start origin; longitudinal toward measured endpoint, lateral left, signed world Z; divide lengths by planar displacement. Missing rows preserved. No endpoint correction.
limitations: Motion timings do not measure grasp/contact.
Inherited landscape calibration/crop and world Z gravity direction remain unverified.
